svg.text: euqalyptus docs · Architecture / Python to HIR, Overview

ol.li: User Python. A snippet showing @QoalaProgram + SDK calls: Remote("Bob"), q = Entangle("Bob"), m = q.measure(), send_int(...).
Pseudo-AST recording. Boxes for QoalaProgram._instance, QoalaModule, QoalaFunction body, with the AST nodes built up: DeclaredRemote, QoalaEprs, MeasureOp, SendIntOp, etc.
MLIR emission. QoalaModule.generate_qoala_hir() walks the AST and calls into qnet.dialects.qnet with Module/Context/InsertionPoint from qnet.ir, producing the textual HIR module.

div.p: Annotate arrows with the method on QoalaProgram/QoalaModule that drives each transition (compile(), generate_qoala_hir()).
